title: Two masked model readers reproduce n categories but disagree on fine k features
statement: Two separate model agents without parent chat history each coded24 masked cards:18 unique prior scan contexts (11N,7K) plus6 repeated contexts, in different random orders. Source labels/mapping and other-reader outputs were withheld; both24-row files were hashed before unmasking. First-presentation n closure agrees11/11 including one shared unclear; 9/11N contexts are jointly accepted and unambiguous, with closure9/9, height9/9 and tip-position8/9 agreement there. For K,6/7contexts are jointly accepted/unambiguous: bar6/6, loop5/6, and foot4/5 on jointly resolved comparisons. Full K feature vectors agree3/7 overall. Both readers repeat their own exact feature vectors on6/6 duplicate pairs. Unmasking shows the broad accepted n categories also occur in hand2, while hand3 k bars are bowed in two herbal contexts and straight in three recipe contexts. The masked re-annotation improves traceable coding but does not establish a unique cross-section hand3 signature.
check: Use independent human paleographers on a prospectively localized complete same-context glyph inventory, including a matched hand5 N control. Keep source labels hidden, report target acceptance and abstention before feature agreement, and adjudicate discrepancies such as terminal feet without changing original ratings. Validate graphical criteria on independently known hands before using them for attribution. This selected18-context model-reader pilot supplies no handwriting identification accuracy.

protocol.source: Frozen previous pilot contexts, no new outcome-selected scan windows.
protocol.scope: Masked re-annotation of a selected descriptive pilot only. It does not repair the incomplete occurrence census.
protocol.analysis: Freeze both annotation files before unmasking. Report per-feature agreement including unclear, agreement on jointly resolved accepted targets, and exact repeated-card consistency. Do not count repeats as independent specimens. Do not infer hand attribution from agreement. Report all ambiguity and disagreements.
protocol.limitations: Root prepared packets and knows labels; independent readers must start without chat history. Shared model and selected prior contexts limit independence. Context wording and visible handwriting may still be recognizable. No external sharing yet.

results.analysis_rule: Use the first presentation of each source context in each reader packet for cross-reader comparisons; repeats only assess within-reader consistency. All unclear counts retained. No p-values or crop-level hand inference.

reader_provenance.caution: Both are model agents with inherited model and same rubric, not human paleographers. Filesystem isolation was by instruction, not a separate access-control sandbox. No source labels were sent to either agent.

limitations: Readers are two isolated runs of the same inherited model with the same rubric, not two human experts or independent paleographic ground truth. Shared model biases may produce agreement.

The root knew source labels while preparing selected pilot contexts. Masking was by packet content and instructions; no separate filesystem access-control sandbox was imposed. Both readers attest packet-only viewing of all24 images.

The18 unique contexts were selected in a prior descriptive pilot, not a complete occurrence census. Repeat cards and paired page sides are not independent handwriting samples; repeated images may be recognized.

All 11N heights were coded high and10closures open, so high agreement partly reflects little category diversity. Jointly resolved agreement excludes ambiguous/unaccepted targets; the full counts and notes are retained.

One reader accepted the hand5 K candidate that the other rejected as ambiguous; no hand5 N control is available. Foot contact also has several disagreements. No source-based adjudication overwrites the original answers.
No hidden-page data, hidden seed, trained handwriting classifier or new attribution verdict was used.

reproduction.usage: Extract files preserving reader_A/reader_B subfolders, then python analyze.py. It verifies committed source-key hash and frozen annotation hashes before comparing first presentations and repeats. No image files are needed to recompute agreement. To regenerate original cards, use source-plan/detail-boxes and exact source JPGs from PR645 under sibling hand3-scans, then prepare.py with the recorded Pillow runtime; do not regenerate or reannotate prior to verifying frozen results.

files.analyze.py:
"""Validate frozen masked annotations, then unmask and compare selected contexts."""
import hashlib,json
from collections import defaultdict,Counter
from pathlib import Path

HERE=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ALLOWED={
 'N':{'closure':{'closed','near','open','unclear'},'tip_position':{'left','over','right','unclear'},'loop_height':{'high','low','unclear'}},
 'K':{'bar':{'straight','bowed','unclear'},'loop':{'round','oval','unclear'},'foot':{'present','absent','unclear'}}}

def digest(path):return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()

def eligible(row):return row['family_accepted']=='yes' and not row['target_ambiguous']

def main():
    protocol=json.loads((HERE/'protocol.json').read_text())
    assert digest(HERE/'private-key.json')==protocol['key_sha256']
    # Refuse unmasking until both final files exist and have been frozen together.
    frozen=json.loads((HERE/'frozen-annotations.json').read_text())
    answers={};cards={}
    for reader in ('A','B'):
        folder=HERE/('reader_'+reader)
        assert digest(folder/'annotations.json')==frozen[reader]['sha256']
        rows=json.loads((folder/'annotations.json').read_text())
        manifest=json.loads((folder/'cards.json').read_text())
        assert [r['id'] for r in rows]==[r['id'] for r in manifest]
        assert len(rows)==24
        cards[reader]={c['id']:c for c in manifest}
        for r in rows:
            family=cards[reader][r['id']]['candidate_family']
            assert r['family_accepted'] in ('yes','no','unclear')
            assert isinstance(r['target_ambiguous'],bool)
            assert r['confidence'] in ('high','medium','low')
            assert isinstance(r['note'],str)
            assert set(r['features'])==set(ALLOWED[family])
            assert all(value in ALLOWED[family][key] for key,value in r['features'].items())
        answers[reader]={r['id']:r for r in rows}
    key=json.loads((HERE/'private-key.json').read_text())
    grouped={};repeats={};first={}
    for reader in ('A','B'):
        grouped[reader]=defaultdict(list)
        for item in key['packets'][reader]:grouped[reader][item['source_index']].append(item)
        first[reader]={i:answers[reader][items[0]['id']] for i,items in grouped[reader].items()}
        duplicate_rows=[]
        for i,items in grouped[reader].items():
            if len(items)<2:continue
            assert len(items)==2
            a,b=[answers[reader][it['id']] for it in items]
            duplicate_rows.append(dict(source_index=i,cards=[it['id'] for it in items],family=items[0]['source']['family'],
                                       family_agrees=a['family_accepted']==b['family_accepted'],
                                       ambiguity_agrees=a['target_ambiguous']==b['target_ambiguous'],
                                       exact_features_agree=a['features']==b['features'],
                                       features={k:dict(first=a['features'][k],repeat=b['features'][k],agree=a['features'][k]==b['features'][k]) for k in a['features']}))
        repeats[reader]=duplicate_rows
    comparisons=[]
    for i in sorted(first['A']):
        a,b=first['A'][i],first['B'][i]
        source=grouped['A'][i][0]['source']
        assert source==grouped['B'][i][0]['source']
        comparisons.append(dict(source_index=i,source=source,A=a,B=b,
                                both_accepted_unambiguous=eligible(a) and eligible(b),
                                family_agrees=a['family_accepted']==b['family_accepted'],
                                ambiguity_agrees=a['target_ambiguous']==b['target_ambiguous'],
                                exact_features_agree=a['features']==b['features']))
    metrics={}
    for family in ('N','K'):
        rows=[r for r in comparisons if r['source']['family']==family]
        m=dict(contexts=len(rows),both_accepted_unambiguous=sum(r['both_accepted_unambiguous'] for r in rows),
               family_agreement=sum(r['family_agrees'] for r in rows),ambiguity_agreement=sum(r['ambiguity_agrees'] for r in rows),
               exact_feature_vector_agreement=sum(r['exact_features_agree'] for r in rows),features={})
        for feature in ALLOWED[family]:
            resolved=[r for r in rows if r['both_accepted_unambiguous'] and all(r[x]['features'][feature]!='unclear' for x in ('A','B'))]
            m['features'][feature]=dict(all_contexts_agree=sum(r['A']['features'][feature]==r['B']['features'][feature] for r in rows),
                                        all_contexts_total=len(rows),jointly_resolved=len(resolved),
                                        jointly_resolved_agree=sum(r['A']['features'][feature]==r['B']['features'][feature] for r in resolved),
                                        paired_values=dict(Counter(r['A']['features'][feature]+'/'+r['B']['features'][feature] for r in rows)))
        metrics[family]=m
    result=dict(protocol=protocol,analysis_rule='Use the first presentation of each source context in each reader packet for cross-reader comparisons; repeats only assess within-reader consistency. All unclear counts retained. No p-values or crop-level hand inference.',
                frozen_annotations=frozen,metrics=metrics,repeated_card_consistency=repeats,comparisons=comparisons,
                files_sha256={n:digest(HERE/n) for n in ('protocol.json','private-key.json','analyze.py')})
    (HERE/'result.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
    print(json.dumps(metrics,indent=2))
    for reader,rows in repeats.items():print(reader,'repeat exact features',sum(r['exact_features_agree'] for r in rows),'/',len(rows))

if __name__=='__main__':main()
files.prepare.py:
"""Create masked reader packets and keep the source key outside the packets."""
import hashlib,json,random,shutil,zipfile
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image,ImageDraw,ImageFont

HERE=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
SOURCE=HERE.parent/'hand3-scans'
OUT=HERE.parents[1]/'outputs'

def main():
    boxes=json.loads((SOURCE/'detail-boxes.json').read_text())
    records=[]
    for page,parts in boxes.items():
        for family,box in parts.items():
            if box is not None:records.append(dict(source=page,family='N' if family.startswith('n') else 'K',context=family,box=box))
    rng=random.Random(2026112701)
    duplicates=[]
    for family in ('N','K'):
        duplicates.extend(rng.sample([i for i,r in enumerate(records) if r['family']==family],3))
    # Source information remains only in the private key. Readers receive no counts by hand/section.
    key={'source_plan_sha256':hashlib.sha256((SOURCE/'plan.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'packets':{}}
    rubric={'task':'Describe only the designated N-like terminal or K-like tall form in each card. Labels refer to candidate families, not accepted identities. Do not guess author, folio, section, date, or any hand label.',
            'independence':'Use only this packet and its images. Do not inspect adjacent folders, source images, other readers, prior chat, internet or manuscript transcriptions. Commit all answers before seeing any source mapping or another reader. These are model-reader observations, not expert paleographic authentication.',
            'target':'For N, assess the terminal returning curve of the rightmost complete minim/terminal sequence in the main crop. For K, assess the main complete tall two-stem upper-loop form. If another form or a cut-off target makes this ambiguous, mark target_ambiguous; do not substitute a different glyph.',
            'required_each_card':['id','family_accepted: yes/no/unclear','target_ambiguous: true/false','features','confidence: high/medium/low','note'],
            'N_features':{'closure':'closed: actual return contact visible; near: visible gap no greater than local stroke thickness; open: wider visible gap; unclear: cannot resolve',
                          'tip_position':'left/over/right/unclear relative to upper start of the final descending minim',
                          'loop_height':'high/low/unclear relative to the preceding minim height'},
            'K_features':{'bar':'straight/bowed/unclear','loop':'round/oval/unclear','foot':'present/absent/unclear; use unclear if adjacent letters or a crop boundary prevent isolating it'},
            'abstention':'Use unclear for indistinct ink or uncertain joins. A visible gap must not be inferred from expected glyph identity. Do not infer stroke order. Report broad similarities only after all individual cards have been coded.',
            'output':'Write annotations.json as a JSON list, one entry per supplied card in order. No hand classification or accuracy claim.'}
    for reader in ('A','B'):
        folder=HERE/('reader_'+reader);folder.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
        order=list(range(len(records)))+duplicates
        random.Random('masked-order/'+reader+'/20261127').shuffle(order)
        rows=[];private=[]
        for ordinal,index in enumerate(order,1):
            identity=hashlib.sha256(f'{reader}/{ordinal}/20261127'.encode()).hexdigest()[:8].upper()
            card_id='C'+identity
            r=records[index];im=Image.open(SOURCE/(r['source']+'.jpg')).crop(tuple(r['box'])).convert('RGB')
            # Fixed 2x display magnification preserves aspect; no contrast/color/sharpness changes.
            im=im.resize((im.width*2,im.height*2),Image.Resampling.NEAREST)
            card=Image.new('RGB',(max(620,im.width+40),max(300,im.height+80)),'white')
            draw=ImageDraw.Draw(card);draw.text((15,12),card_id+' / candidate '+r['family'],fill='black')
            card.paste(im,((card.width-im.width)//2,55))
            path=folder/(card_id+'.png');card.save(path)
            rows.append(dict(id=card_id,file=path.name,candidate_family=r['family'],sha256=hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()))
            private.append(dict(id=card_id,source_index=index,source=r,duplicate_of_source=index in duplicates))
        (folder/'cards.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n')
        (folder/'rubric.json').write_text(json.dumps(rubric,indent=2)+'\n')
        key['packets'][reader]=private
    (HERE/'private-key.json').write_text(json.dumps(key,indent=2)+'\n')
    commitment=hashlib.sha256((HERE/'private-key.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    protocol={'key_sha256':commitment,'unique_source_contexts':len(records),'cards_per_reader':len(records)+len(duplicates),
              'reader_count_planned':2,'source':'Frozen previous pilot contexts, no new outcome-selected scan windows.',
              'scope':'Masked re-annotation of a selected descriptive pilot only. It does not repair the incomplete occurrence census.',
              'analysis':'Freeze both annotation files before unmasking. Report per-feature agreement including unclear, agreement on jointly resolved accepted targets, and exact repeated-card consistency. Do not count repeats as independent specimens. Do not infer hand attribution from agreement. Report all ambiguity and disagreements.',
              'limitations':'Root prepared packets and knows labels; independent readers must start without chat history. Shared model and selected prior contexts limit independence. Context wording and visible handwriting may still be recognizable. No external sharing yet.'}
    (HERE/'protocol.json').write_text(json.dumps(protocol,indent=2)+'\n')
    OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    dest=OUT/'hand3-masked-reader-packets.zip'
    with zipfile.ZipFile(dest,'w',zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as z:
        for reader in ('A','B'):
            for path in sorted((HERE/('reader_'+reader)).iterdir()):z.write(path,'reader_'+reader+'/'+path.name)
        z.write(HERE/'protocol.json','protocol.json')
    print(json.dumps({'unique_contexts':len(records),'cards_per_reader':len(records)+len(duplicates),'key_sha256':commitment,'zip_bytes':dest.stat().st_size}))

if __name__=='__main__':main()
